summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC), a Taiwan-based semiconductor foundry, reporting routine corporate updates. The filing announces board-approved Q2 2026 consolidated financial statements, a capital budget execution of NT$148,680 million for fab expansions in Singapore and Tainan to meet AI demand, cancellation of restricted shares, and an investment in TGVest Asia Partners III. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, or deal terminations. The filing is a standard current report of foreign issuer under Rule 13a-16.
